title: ux-paths target finding map
description: <auditDir>/target/finding-map.json. Read by `ux-paths synthesize-target` to regenerate DECISIONS.md section 7 (everything after `<!-- generated:findings -->`). `defaults` maps an as-built path ID to the decision IDs applied to every S1/S2 finding on that path unless overridden per finding in `findings`. `OPEN` (alone or alongside decision IDs) leaves the finding open; the reason is recorded in the covering target path file's header, not here. Validated by scripts/lib/config.mjs's hand-rolled subset (type, required, properties, additionalProperties, pattern, items, minItems). patternProperties is checked by loadFindingMap directly, named in projects/README.md.

defaults.description: Path ID (the lane's asBuiltPrefix plus a number, e.g. "W2") -> decision IDs applied to every S1/S2 finding on that path unless a finding-level override exists.

findings.description: Finding ID (path ID plus "-" plus a two-digit number, e.g. "W2-01") -> decision IDs, overriding the path's default for that one finding.

observed.description: Notes made while drawing the target, for the build. Not findings; no finding ID or decision ID needed.
